glossary.definition: (1) "Community early childhood facility" means a facility in which early childhood services are provided.
glossary.source_title: Section 5123.378 - Authority to change terms of agreement regarding the construction, acquisition, or renovation of community early childhood facility.

glossary.definition: (2) "Early childhood services" has the same meaning as in section 5126.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5123.378 - Authority to change terms of agreement regarding the construction, acquisition, or renovation of community early childhood facility.
